pr_title: Fix dev server serving inline bundles
pr_body:
Fixes #6043. Fix recommended by @mischnic Dev server fails when serving inline bundle processed by @parcel/transformer-raw I would consider this as regression bug, because it worked with parcel@2.0.0-beta.2 and @parcel/transformer-raw@2.0.0-beta.2 ## 💻 Examples package.json ``` { "name": "parcel-serve-fails-for-inlines", "scripts": { "serve": "parcel serve ./src/index.html" }, "devDependencies": { "parcel": "2.0.0-nightly.632" } } ``` .parcelrc ``` { "extends": "@parcel/config-default", "transformers": { "*.props": ["@parcel/transformer-raw"] }, } ``` index.html ``` Title

Test

Thank you for the hint. Find the trigger for the error was tricky. Because "Error: Got unexpected null" was raised only when non-existing file was requested. Get default page scenario is actually covered by three tests (each is using integration/html/index.html template):
- should serve a default page if the main bundle is an HTML asset
- should serve a default page if the main bundle is an HTML asset even if it is not called index
- should serve a default page if the main bundle is an HTML asset with package.json#source

So I added inline style to integration/html/index.html and fixed missing inline bundles in other tests which also use this template.
Tests passed, the fix is ready for merge.

It's intentional that inline bundles don't have a file path, as they are never written to disk directly (and namer plugins aren't invoked for them).

However this bug is blocking my development, so should I finish this pull request as a quick fix, or you change `getBundles` method soon?
